## Description

Hold exposure near the close and exit near the next open, isolating overnight returns from intraday returns.

## Where it may fit

Historical samples where overnight returns differ systematically from intraday returns.

## Vehicles

Equity-index ETF overlays, intraday systematic funds.

## Required data

Accurate close/open prices, dividends, after-hours/pre-market treatment, spread and slippage data.

## Caveats

Execution at official close/open prices is difficult; historical decomposition is not automatically tradable.
